notes.value: Bridging ICAP finance: bridging interest capitalised loan - servicing is assessed on the end debt amount where applicable. Bridging facility can be in place for up to 12 months. Portability allows customers to switch securities with no changes to the loan details or loan serviceability assessment.

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: Stated as 'Max LVR 95% for Owner Occupier and 90% for Investor (inclusive of LMI) or 80% LVR without LMI' in the Construction section, and the Medico LMI waiver reaches 95% LVR. The page does not state a single general purchase ceiling. Live broker policy page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

maxLvrInvestmentPct.note: 'Up to 90% LVR for Investment Property loans with Interest Only repayments (inclusive of LMI)'; Construction section also states 90% for Investor. Live broker policy page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

maxLvrNoLmiPct.note: 'or 80% LVR without LMI' (Construction section). LMI waiver niches reach 90-95% without LMI for eligible professions. Live broker policy page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

lmiInclusiveOfMaxLvr.note: Maximum LVRs are stated as '(inclusive of LMI)'. Live broker policy page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

value.conditions: Eligible Emergency Services frontline employed applicants could have their overtime and allowances assessed at 100% (conditions apply). Eligible professions include: Fire Officers or Firefighters; Police Officers; Ambulance Officers or Paramedics; Hospital employed Nurses, Doctors, Surgeons or Specialists.

value.evidence: Latest two years' individual ATO Notices of Assessment (Fast Track method)
value.conditions: Fast Track method available for borrowing up to 80% LVR. Eligible Medico clients can still get LMI waivers up to 95%. For non-Fast Track applications the lender may accept a 1 Year Assessment or latest year income for servicing for those who meet the criteria. Source wording is 'self-employed clients' and does not distinguish trading structure.

rentalLedgerAsGenuineSavings.note: 'For those who are currently renting, minimum of 3 months of continuous rental history can be used as proof of genuine savings.' A separate 6-month continuous rental history option applies where the loan is for an owner-occupied residence or established owner-occupied dwelling (or vacant land with a construction application), all tenants on the lease are borrowers, and the property is leased through a licensed property manager/agent (excludes family/private). gaps: Assessment buffer, assessment rate floor, DTI cap, rental shading, credit card assessment rate and HEM basis are not published on any public Westpac Group broker page - the serviceability calculator and full Credit Policy are behind the BrokerHub login.
General (non-construction) maximum LVR for owner-occupied and investment purchases is not stated as a single figure; the values recorded are read from the Construction and Investor sections.
The live policy page says 90% LVR for Investment Property Loans with Interest Only repayments while the February 2026 broker niche PDF says 95% on the same line - unresolved conflict.
No published employment tenure minimums (probation, casual, contract), credit-history knock-outs (defaults, bankruptcy, arrears), or security/postcode restrictions.
Minimum and maximum loan amounts, maximum loan term and interest-only maximum terms are not published on the broker policy page.
Temporary-visa and NZ-citizen treatment is not published; only 'not available for Non-Australian Resident borrowers' is stated.
